args.title: Fix scheduled exports to send initial export on creation day
args.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

The firstRunAt function uses nextRunAt with the schedule cadence and the current time to determine the next run time for sending scheduled exports. However, if a weekly schedule is created early in the day, it might compute the next run time to be the next week instead of the same day, causing the first scheduled export email to be skipped on creation day.

This pull request proposes investigating and correcting the logic in firstRunAt or nextRunAt usage to ensure that when a weekly schedule is created, the first export is properly scheduled to be sent the same day if applicable, fixing the issue where the first weekly export is sent only a week later.
